originalTitle: Adolescence or The Traitors? Netflix neck-and-neck with BBC as British viewers’ go-to
summary: Amid slowing streaming market, Netflix still produces hits that help make it default service for quarter of Britons
content: Netflix is neck-and-neck with the BBC as the default service Britons turn to when they switch on their TV, according to research. The home of Adolescence and KPop Demon Hunters is now the first port of call for 26% of viewers, Ofcom found. The national broadcaster is narrowly behind, as the go-to for 25% of audiences.. Although growth in streaming platforms has slowed in the UK, Netflix in particular is still producing breakthrough hits with audiences. Ofcom’s annual Media Nations report showed the hit film Kpop Demon Hunters and the crime drama Adolescence were the most watched in the UK in 2025, with the former reaching an audience of more than 24 million; the latter 16 million. The Netflix app comes with many smart TVs or streaming devices but users still need to pay for a subscription to watch it. However, Ofcom said viewing figures for the start of 2026 showed the BBC mounting a fightback, with the latest series of The Traitors and Tom Hiddleston’s return to The Night Manager topping the ratings. That trend has continued into the summer thanks to the BBC and ITV’s coverage of the World Cup. Kate Davies, the group director for strategy and research at Ofcom, said traditional broadcasters were showing “resilience” through their live and event TV programming. Describing the competitive landscape between the likes of the BBC, Sky, Netflix and Google-owned YouTube as “fierce”, she added: “To thrive and survive in the current media landscape, it’s more important than ever for companies to continue to understand changing audience habits and adapt their strategies to meet people where they are.” Citing another set of data from the audience measurement body Barb, Ofcom said the BBC remained ahead of other platforms in terms of share of total video viewing, accounting for 18% of the total in 2025, followed by YouTube on 15%, ITV on 11% and Netflix on 9%. YouTube is also becoming more of a fixture of TV viewing, with the amount it is viewed on people’s TV sets doubling over the past four years. There were also signs of a drop off among young audiences, with steep declines in live TV viewing among 16- to 24-year-olds and 4- to 15-year-olds of 17% each, although Ofcom said this was partly due to the absence of major sporting events in 2025, compared with the boost from the Paris Olympics and Euro 2024 the previous year. But alternative video viewing services were not necessarily the beneficiaries of the decline of young viewership numbers for broadcasters. Ofcom said young adults continue to watch TV and film less and less, watching 11 fewer minutes of broadcast, streaming and on-demand services at home last year, due to the allure of alternatives such as social media and gaming. Despite Netflix, Amazon, Disney+ and Apple shooting big series in the UK in recent years, from Sex Education to Masters of the Air to Rivals, public services broadcasters led by the BBC, ITV and Channel 4 delivered more than 30,000 hours of UK-originated content last year, not including repeats.
chineseTitle: 青春期还是叛徒？ Netflix 与 BBC 并驾齐驱，成为英国观众的首选
chineseSummary: 在流媒体市场放缓的情况下，Netflix 仍然产生热门内容，使其成为四分之一英国人的默认服务
chineseContent: 研究显示，作为英国人打开电视时的默认服务，Netflix 与 BBC 并驾齐驱。 Ofcom 发现，《青春期》和《韩国流行音乐恶魔猎人》的故乡现在是 26% 观众的第一站。这家国家广播公司以微弱优势落后，成为 25% 观众的首选。尽管英国流媒体平台的增长放缓，但 Netflix 仍在为观众带来突破性的热门内容。 Ofcom的年度Media Nations报告显示，热门电影《韩流恶魔猎人》和犯罪剧《青春期》是2025年英国收视率最高的电影，前者的观众人数超过2400万；后者1600万。许多智能电视或流媒体设备都配备了 Netflix 应用程序，但用户仍然需要付费才能观看。然而，Ofcom 表示，2026 年初的收视数据显示，BBC 正在发起反击，最新剧集《叛徒》和汤姆·希德勒斯顿回归《夜班经理》收视率名列前茅。由于 BBC 和 ITV 对世界杯的报道，这种趋势一直持续到夏季。 Ofcom 战略与研究小组总监凯特·戴维斯 (Kate Davies) 表示，传统广播公司通过直播和活动电视节目表现出了“弹性”。她将 BBC、Sky、Netflix 和谷歌旗下 YouTube 等公司之间的竞争格局描述为“激烈”，并补充道：“为了在当前的媒体格局中蓬勃发展和生存，公司比以往任何时候都更重要的是继续了解不断变化的受众习惯并调整策略以满足人们的需求。” Ofcom援引观众测量机构Barb的另一组数据称，BBC在总视频观看份额方面仍领先于其他平台，占18%
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
